I can't give you the name. All I have for Driftmoor's night-dispatch contact is something Kwame told me in a direct message, and I can't pass that on to someone who wasn't part of it. Nothing in #coastal-team or the shared notes names the contact. The notes only say that engineering gave the night dispatcher a manual CSV patch for the failed tide-table import.

The quickest route is to ask Kwame directly, and he can share the name with you himself.

Also, a note to a Driftmoor contact would go outside pemberline.com. I'd need Ruth Calloway's approval before I could even draft it. Once you have the name and address, tell me and I'll ask Ruth.
